workouts.description:
Warmup: 10 min — Easy spin + body check (saddle height, tire pressure, drivetrain)
20 min: Skills focus — (Climbing technique) Seat-stay climbs — slide forward, drive heels, hold a steady cadence (75–85 rpm). 4–6 short climbs.; (Line choice) Pick three lines on the same trail section, ride each 3×, compare flow and exit speed.; (Cornering) Outside foot down, eyes on exit, lean bike not body. 8–12 reps each direction.
Cooldown: 5 min — Easy spin
